message.cassino.slot.jackpot_broadcast: %s hit the JACKPOT and won %s chips!
gui.cassino.slot.paytable: Pays on the middle line: 3, 4 or 5 in a row from the left (times the bet)
gui.cassino.slot.tip.deposit: Deposits the chips in the slot next to it: each chip becomes 1 credit. Credits are yours only, work on any slot machine and stay saved when you close it
gui.cassino.slot.tip.withdraw: Cashes out all your credits as chips
gui.cassino.slot.paytable.jackpot: Jackpot (five 7s): 100x + %s%% of the house pool with a bet of %s (smaller bets get a proportional part)
